F-V01-13-SECURITY-RECOVERY-OBSERVABILITY.goal: Crash/restart/rollback/quarantine/rebuild, identity continuity, stale-state rejection, prompt/tool-result injection resistance, telemetry and complete reproducible receipts.
F-V01-13-SECURITY-RECOVERY-OBSERVABILITY.blocker: External execution-generation floor candidate #240 is target-VPS PASS for DB-snapshot rollback when its external anchor survives, but it is not product-integrated and does not prove semantic-root identity for equal-generation divergent/sibling states. In addition, the accepted target currently reports SQLite 3.45.1 while Frank uses WAL; upstream SQLite documents the WAL-reset corruption race for versions through 3.51.2 under concurrent writer/checkpoint topology. Release must therefore fail closed until the exact Ubuntu build is proven to contain the upstream fix/backport, the runtime is upgraded to a fixed SQLite build, or a machine-checked Frank topology proves the trigger conditions unreachable. Recovery/boot continuity must still select one provenance-bound semantic lineage head and remain fail-closed when external anchors are absent or rolled back.
